title: Confirmation of Results
description: Draft public-service guidance; review questions must be resolved before publication.
clarifying_questions: Is an employer or institution requesting confirmation, or do you need help with a lost certificate?

claims.text: Apply through the Query Management Information System. Supply examination identity, school/centre, certificate evidence and the receiving institution address; business/technical requests also need the series.
If certificate/results-slip evidence is missing, obtain a certified results printout through the appropriate former institution or education office. Primary results-slip year restrictions apply.
The statement is for the employer/institution, not the candidate or family; it cannot be redirected and is not a certificate.
The charter lists KES 2,320 per certificate for confirmation within Kenya and KES 3,480 outside Kenya.
The guideline charges modular courses per certificate and per module; do not treat one displayed tariff as the total for all modules.
Single and Group certificates are charged per stage when all or part of that stage is submitted together in one application.
The guideline warns that examinations from 1926 to 1984 may require longer processing.
Submit each examination in its own application with its certificate, result slip or certified results printout.
Provide the applicant contact address and mobile number for clarification.
The guideline lists archives@knec.ac.ke and ceo@knec.ac.ke for further enquiries.
The public poster directs users from the KNEC website to QMIS, then registration/login, service details and attachments, submission for verification, and status checking for payment.

unresolved_questions: Resolve fax/email dispatch terminology and overseas-payment instructions before publishing fees as a full quote.
Confirm current portal and payment prompts; retain destination and module/stage context when quoting.
Named content approval and current applicability review remain required.
